executiveSummary: Active, AI-assisted exploitation targeting Siemens S7 PLCs across U.S. critical sectors (including Water and Wastewater) is confirmed by a multi-agency advisory. Immediate removal of Internet exposure, segmentation, and S7comm monitoring are required. Security Advisory U.S. Water/Wastewater facilities experienced direct PLC lockouts (password/IP changes), forcing manual operations and public safety notices-indicating active OT impact. Security Advisory Critical perimeter gateways and management systems (NetScaler ADC/Gateway pre-auth RCE, VMware vCenter, JetBrains TeamCity, Metabase) continue to be exploited for initial access and webshell persistence, increasing IT-to-OT pivot risk. Advisory Weekly Report Eclipse Milo OPC UA vulnerabilities (authorization bypass, diagnostics exposure, padding-oracle, monitored item exhaustion) present direct ICS disruption and information leakage risks on widely deployed OPC UA servers. CISA Bulletin State-sponsored operations leveraging compromised edge devices and routers are pre-positioning in critical infrastructure networks; urgent router hygiene (SNMPv3, disabling Smart Install, AAA hardening) and segmentation are advised. Security Advisory Confirmed destructive OT intrusion via misconfigured private APN led to a turbine and process-water shutdown at a CHP plant, demonstrating a repeatable cellular pathway risk into OT. Incident Report

items: State-sponsored operations abusing compromised routers/edge devices for pre-positioning in CI networks; tactics include SNMP config theft, Smart Install abuse, GRE/IPsec tunnels, and traffic mirroring. Security Advisory
Pro-Russia hacktivist groups opportunistically access Internet-exposed VNC on HMIs, altering setpoints and suppressing alarms (Water, Food & Agriculture, Energy). Security Advisory
Head Mare APT exploiting TrueConf Server to deploy PhantomCore/PhantomGraph backdoors; targets include energy and transportation, enabling IT-to-OT pivot potential. Supporting Report
APT29 subclusters abuse OAuth/device linking and captive portal AitM (identity takeover) impacting enterprise SSO that may front OT portals. View Article

relevance: Multiple concurrent drivers raise OT risk to a critical level: (1) confirmed field impact in Water/Wastewater; (2) credible, AI-assisted PLC exploitation workflows targeting Siemens S7 families; (3) active exploitation of identity, remote access, and CI/CD systems that commonly bridge IT to OT; and (4) ICS-native protocol exposure (OPC UA/Milo). Organizations should assume elevated likelihood of attempts to access engineering workstations, historians, and PLCs via exposed IT perimeters, vendor remote access, or misconfigured cellular paths. Prioritize near-term actions listed below to reduce blast radius and detect intrusions rapidly.

items: Siemens Desigo DXR/PXC BACnet DoS via malformed packets; patch firmware and segment BACnet (UDP 47808). Security Advisory
Johnson Controls Simplex Incident Manager credential exposure in memory; patch to v2.01.01 and harden local access. Security Advisory
Eclipse Milo (OPC UA) issues affecting authorization, diagnostics, crypto, and DoS. CISA Bulletin
EVSE exposures (EVbee DC-80/Autel) include unauthenticated RCE, unsigned firmware, and OCPP abuse; segment EVSE networks and enforce mTLS. CISA Bulletin
NetScaler ADC/Gateway RCE (CVE-2026-8452) and critical auth bypass-rapid exploitation history; patch and hunt for webshells. Advisory
JFrog Artifactory cache/metadata poisoning threats to CI/CD supply chains feeding OT deployments; patch and enforce artifact signing. View Article

descriptions: Initial access: Exploitation of public-facing applications (NetScaler SAML overflow; vCenter traversal; TeamCity deserialization), abuse of exposed VNC/SSO/OAuth flows, router/SOHO compromise.
Persistence: Webshells under NetScaler /var/vpn/theme; rogue admin users on vCenter/TeamCity; container/Guest Shell enablement on network gear.
Lateral movement: Valid accounts, Impacket tools, VPN pivot via stolen credentials; abuse of AD/SSO and RMM platforms.
ICS impacts: S7comm memory/logic writes; OPC UA MonitoredItem flooding; setpoint manipulation and alarm suppression on HMIs.
Exfiltration/C2: Cloud relays (Microsoft Graph/OneDrive), DNS over HTTPS, residential proxy/IP masking.

outlook72h: Expect continued scanning and exploitation of NetScaler ADC/Gateway and Metabase/TeamCity/vCenter instances; prioritize patching, webroot integrity checks, and SSO hardening. Increase monitoring for S7comm anomalies and unauthorized online logic changes across S7-1200/1500 fleets; schedule targeted maintenance windows for firmware updates. Conduct emergency APN and remote-access reviews for any cellular pathways touching OT; enforce device isolation at the carrier and enterprise edge. Proactively hunt for OPC UA (Milo) service anomalies and disable diagnostics endpoints exposed beyond trusted zones.
